nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Daily at 08:00. To change the time, edit triggerAtHour above (24-h format). For a full cron expression use rule.interval[0].field = 'cronExpression' and set e.g. '0 9 * * *' for 9 AM.

nodes.name: Read Project Log
nodes.notes: After import: select the 'Project Log' spreadsheet and its sheet from the dropdowns (or paste the spreadsheet ID).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: 'You are a standup assistant. For each project below, write one short, warm paragraph (2-3 sentences) reconstructing where the user left off, ending with a single concrete next action. Do not pad with generic advice or restate the raw input verbatim. Keep the full output scannable in under 30 seconds.' }] }, contents: [ { role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $json.formattedText }] } ] }) }}

nodes.name: Gemini LLM – Digest
nodes.notes: Credential 'Gemini API': Header Auth with Name = 'x-goog-api-key', Value = '<YOUR_GEMINI_KEY>' (no 'Bearer' prefix — that's an OpenAI/Groq convention, not Gemini's). Model name may need updating over time — check https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing for the current free-tier Flash model if you get a 'model does not exist' error.

nodes.name: Send Telegram Digest
nodes.notes: Set n8n variable MY_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID to your Telegram chat ID. See SETUP.md. Text field reads Gemini's response shape (candidates[0].content.parts[0].text) — do NOT use the old choices[0].message.content path, which silently resolves to 'undefined'.
